description: Project module for the Styio compiler, runtime, parser, IDE, and LSP repositories.
technology_stack: C++ compiler/runtime code built with CMake and CTest
Tree-sitter grammar and parser shadow tooling
Python and Bash repository gates, docs automation, fuzz and benchmark scripts
Rust, JavaScript, TypeScript, Zig, Nix, and Bazel fixture/tooling surfaces present in the repository
internal_components: StyioAST, StyioAnalyzer, StyioIR, and StyioCodeGen compiler pipeline
StyioRuntime and StyioExtern runtime and external resource layer
StyioIDE and StyioLSP editor-facing workspace services
StyioParser parser route and shadow comparison pipeline
Security, pipeline, fuzz, benchmark, and checkpoint gate suites
Docs, workflow, and repo hygiene automation
open_source_components: Fixture-only Rust, JavaScript, TypeScript, Zig, Nix, and Bazel ecosystems requiring per-manifest evidence when promoted

resource_classes.description: Owns AST nodes, analyzer bindings, IR nodes, lowering products, and LLVM emission inputs.
resource_classes.copying_policy: AST and IR cloning must be explicit, bounded, and covered by regression tests for every accepted syntax family.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Compiler data structures are single-session by default; cross-session sharing must be immutable or protected by a documented owner boundary.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Nullable AST/IR pointers are allowed only at parse boundaries and must be checked before dereference or converted into typed diagnostics.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Ownership must terminate through RAII containers, unique ownership, or session teardown that is covered by sanitizer or regression tests.

state_machine.source: C++ ownership types, node variants, lowering contracts, diagnostics, CTest, and ASan/UBSan runs.

transitions.on: IR lowering emits a supported form
unsupported or invalid node produces diagnostics

invalid_operations: returning placeholder values for unsupported nodes
dereferencing nullable child pointers without a valid state

required_tests: targeted CTest tests for touched syntax, sema, lowering, and codegen paths
ASan/UBSan leg when ownership or pointer behavior changes

resource_classes.description: Owns runtime handles, external resources, file and stream operations, runtime buffers, and security-sensitive IO.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Runtime buffers and external payloads must have documented size caps or streaming behavior before copies are accepted.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Shared runtime state must declare lock ownership and avoid blocking IO while holding locks.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Invalid handles, absent files, and missing streams must be represented as explicit failure states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Files, streams, handles, and buffers must be released on success, failure, timeout, and partial initialization.

state_machine.source: Runtime handle wrappers, security tests, pipeline tests, soak tests, and sanitizer gates.

required_tests: security-labeled CTest coverage for changed IO paths
pipeline case covering success and failure behavior
soak or sanitizer coverage for lifetime-sensitive paths
required_gates: benchmark/soak-minimize.sh when long-running resource behavior changes

resource_classes.description: Owns workspace indexing, semantic caches, document snapshots, LSP request state, and editor-facing diagnostics.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Document snapshots and semantic summaries must avoid broad rescans or repeated full copies without coalescing evidence.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Background indexing must use bounded queues, coalescing, and workspace-scoped cancellation.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing documents, stale snapshots, and absent semantic data must produce structured empty or failed states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Caches and background jobs must be invalidated when documents, roots, or capabilities change.

state_machine.source: IDE service types, LSP handlers, corpus tests, fuzz gates, and performance gates.

transitions.on: document or workspace root is opened
document or file-watch event changes state
parse or filesystem failure is classified

required_tests: IDE unit or corpus regression for touched behavior
LSP transcript or server test for protocol changes
fuzz smoke for parser/LSP sync boundary changes
required_gates: scripts/ide-fuzz-gate.sh when parse or sync behavior changes
scripts/ide-perf-gate.sh when indexing or cache behavior changes

resource_classes.description: Owns parser route transitions, tree-sitter grammar state, shadow comparisons, and cutover evidence.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Parser tokens, syntax nodes, and shadow artifacts must avoid unbounded duplication and keep minimized repros for mismatches.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Parser gates are batch-oriented; shared artifacts must be written to isolated output directories.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Unsupported syntax must be rejected with diagnostics or excluded by an explicit capability state.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Shadow artifacts, fuzz outputs, and generated reports must stay out of tracked source unless summarized into docs.

state_machine.source: Parser route stats, shadow gates, grammar tests, fuzz corpus, and benchmark reports.

transitions.on: new parser route is enabled behind comparison
mismatch or unsupported syntax is found

invalid_operations: accepting syntax without lowering or rejection

required_tests: parser shadow suite for route changes
fuzz corpus update for recovery or grammar changes
milestone or pipeline case for accepted syntax
